changelog:
v2.0.1 — Beautiful Dashboard Edition:

• Brand new dashboard: hero Guardian card, grouped category cards, neon glow design
• New Calls section (Quick Dial + recent calls log) in its own folder
• Quran Audio room added — coming soon (full recitation player in development)
• SECURITY HARDENING:
  - Update APKs now signature-verified before install (forged updates blocked)
  - Code fully obfuscated + shrunk (6MB → 1.35MB, much harder to reverse-engineer)
  - HTTPS-only network policy, backups disabled, debug logging stripped
• Installing this over v2.0.0 works — no uninstall needed
